status: cache-only draft requires repair before tests or promotion

findings.issue: Cleanup method can retire store during active Run publication.
findings.required: Refuse cleanup before actual publication worker joins and retires.

findings.issue: State lock spans filesystem IO and failure warning path blocks on the same mutex.
findings.required: Bound state handoff; retain store before IO and use short snapshots or single-producer safe publication.

findings.issue: Exhausted IO budget can prevent duplicate lease retirement and block genuine retry.
findings.required: Retire only quiescent publication and consume exact duplicate lease without further history publication; retain root/stage cleanup owner.

findings.issue: Starting shared cleanup envelope during optional history work could expire it before long-lived core teardown.
findings.required: Start shared envelope only at actual Run teardown after worker join; terminal publication remains synchronous within startup remaining budget.

laterFindings.issue: Public warning errors can expose active store cleanup through wrapped Close capability.
laterFindings.required: Keep exact warning and cleanup ancestry private; public warning has only fixed non-capability-bearing data. Concrete cleanup access is allowed only after actual publication retirement.
